questions.title: Most Water Area
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by water area (inland + coastal + Great Lakes + territorial) in square miles.

source.name: US Census Bureau, State Area Measurements (water area)

questions.title: Longest Tidal Shoreline (NOAA)
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by NOAA tidal shoreline length — includes the shoreline of bays, sounds, and islands, not just the outer coastline miles.
questions.disclaimer: NOAA's 'shoreline' figure counts all tidal shoreline including bays, sounds, and islands, and is much larger than the simple outer 'coastline' distance. States with heavy inlet/island geography beat states with long straight coasts. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: Wikipedia — List of U.S. states and territories by coastline (NOAA methodology)

questions.title: Highest Peak Elevation
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by the elevation of their highest natural point (USGS).
questions.disclaimer: All top-10 state high points are in the West except (technically) they all are — the highest peak east of the Mississippi is Mount Mitchell in North Carolina at 6,684 ft, which doesn't crack the top 15. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: Wikipedia — List of U.S. states by elevation (sourced from USGS)

questions.title: Highest Mean (Average) Elevation
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by mean elevation above sea level.
questions.disclaimer: Statewide mean elevation above sea level, per USGS reference values. Some Plains states rank surprisingly high because their western edges climb toward the Rockies. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: Wikipedia — List of U.S. states by elevation (sourced from USGS)

questions.title: Most National Parks
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by number of designated National Parks (NPS 'National Park' designation only — not the 400+ broader NPS units).
questions.disclaimer: 'National Park' is a specific NPS designation — the broader 'National Park System' includes 400+ units (monuments, seashores, historic sites) but the traditional 'National Park' title is much rarer. Excludes national monuments, historic sites, seashores, and recreation areas. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: National Park Service — List of National Parks
source.asOf: 2024 (63 designated National Parks after New River Gorge 2020 and Indiana Dunes 2019)

answers.value: 1 National Park (Great Smoky, tied w/ NC)
1 National Park (Great Smoky, tied w/ TN)

questions.title: Most National Forest Acreage
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by acreage of National Forest System land managed by the USDA Forest Service.
questions.disclaimer: National Forest acreage differs from BLM land — the Forest Service manages ~193M acres nationally. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: Wikipedia — List of national forests of the United States

questions.title: Snowiest States (Average Annual Snowfall)
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by average annual snowfall statewide (NOAA / NCEI climate normals).
questions.disclaimer: Statewide average annual snowfall, averaged across the entire state's land area (NOAA 1991-2020 climate normals). Statewide averages differ substantially from 'snowiest cities' rankings because of how snowfall varies within a state. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Highest Average Annual Temperature
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by average annual mean temperature (NOAA / NCEI 1991-2020 climate normals).
questions.disclaimer: Statewide average annual mean temperature (Fahrenheit), NOAA 1991-2020 climate normals, averaged across the entire state's land area. Includes both non-contiguous states. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NOAA NCEI — Statewide Average Temperature Rankings
source.asOf: NOAA 1991-2020 30-year climate normals; annual rank data through 2023

questions.title: Highest Life Expectancy
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by life expectancy at birth (CDC, 2020).
questions.disclaimer: Life expectancy at birth in years, 2020 (COVID-affected). DC included.

source.name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics, US State Life Expectancy

questions.title: Highest Adult Obesity Rate
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by adult obesity prevalence (CDC BRFSS, 2022).
questions.disclaimer: Percent of adults (18+) with BMI >= 30 based on self-reported height/weight. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS)

questions.title: Highest Adult Smoking Rate
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by adult cigarette smoking prevalence (CDC BRFSS, 2022).
questions.disclaimer: Percent of adults (18+) who currently smoke cigarettes every day or some days. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: CDC STATE System — Tobacco Use Data Portal

questions.title: Highest Opioid Overdose Death Rate
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by age-adjusted opioid overdose death rate per 100,000 (CDC, 2021).
questions.disclaimer: Age-adjusted deaths involving any opioid per 100,000 population, 2021. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: CDC — Overdose Prevention: Data & Research (SUDORS / NCHS)

questions.title: Highest Suicide Rate
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by age-adjusted suicide rate per 100,000 (CDC, 2021).
questions.disclaimer: Age-adjusted suicide deaths per 100,000 population, 2021. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: CDC NCHS, Suicide Mortality by State

questions.title: Highest Uninsured Rate
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by percent of population without health insurance (KFF/Census, 2022).
questions.disclaimer: Percent of nonelderly population without health insurance coverage. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: KFF — Health Insurance Coverage of the Total Population

questions.title: Highest Renewable Electricity Share
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by share of in-state electricity generation from renewables (EIA, 2023).
questions.disclaimer: Renewables include hydro, wind, solar, geothermal, biomass. Percent of total in-state generation. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Energy Information Administration (EIA), Electric Power Monthly

questions.title: Largest Solar Electricity Generation
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by utility-scale solar photovoltaic electricity generation (EIA, 2023).
questions.disclaimer: Total utility-scale solar PV generation in gigawatt-hours (GWh), 2023. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Energy Information Administration (EIA), Electric Power Monthly
